quests.title: Homecoming's Faint Glow

dialogue.t: Hmm. The atmosphere's a little unusual today. Are you decorating this flower field, Columbina?
Ah, that wasn't me. It was them.
You mean... the kuuhenki?
Yes. These stones emit a faint light upon absorbing kuuvahki. The kuuhenki are quite fond of them.
So they just... put them on the ground and play with them?
Not exactly. Come over here and look.
Huh...?
Ooh! It forms a picture when you look at it from above!

dialogue.sit: Looks like we're a chunk short, though...

dialogue.t: That's right. I need to go collect some more.
Oh, so you're heading out?
Yes, I know just the place — it's graced by the moon, so these kinds of stones are abundant.
Sure.
Alright, then let's get collecting! We wanna see what the finished picture looks like, too!
This should be enough, right? Feels like we grabbed a whole bunch.
C'mon, let's head back. Can't leave that artwork incomplete forever, right?
*sob*
Aaahh! Quick, hide! Someone's here!
*sob* Where am I... Mommy... I wanna go home...
Looks like she's one of the Frostmoon Scions. Is she lost?
You will?
Yeah, of course! She sure looks like she needs it!
The Frostmoon Scions are deeply wary of outsiders, correct? You have no antlers, the hour is late... What if you scare her off instead...
Okay, that could happen, but we can't just do nothing!
Hmm... Come with me, then.
Huh?
*whimper* ... Huh? What's this...
It's... so pretty...
That should do it.
And off she goes. That trail of stone should lead her back to the Frostmoon Enclave.

dialogue.sit: (Columbina says she doesn't want to be treated like a god, but she helps those in need all the same...)

dialogue.t: Wait, but what about the painting...
It's alright.
We can finish it some other time.
I like watching people find their way back home, to the place where they belong.

quests.description: The kuuhenki are up to something interesting in the Silvermoon Hall…
